title.en: Song of White Snow, Seeing Off Secretary Wu on His Return to the Capital

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 770.

note.en: Cen Shen served for years with the armies of the far northwest, and he wrote this at Luntai, near the Tian Shan, around 754. Its most famous line turns a snowstorm in the eighth month into a spring morning of pear blossom on ten thousand trees. The ending is one of the great farewells: the friend has gone round the bend, and the poet keeps looking at the hoofprints in the snow.
note.zh: 岑参多年在西北边塞军中任职，这首诗约 754 年作于天山脚下的轮台。最有名的一句，把八月的一场暴雪写成了千树万树梨花开的春晨。结尾是最好的送别之一：朋友已经转过山弯，诗人还望着雪上留下的马蹄印。

excerpt.orig: 忽如一夜春風來，千樹萬樹梨花開。
excerpt.en: As if overnight a spring wind had come, / and on a thousand trees, ten thousand trees, the pear blossom opened.
excerpt.zh: 忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开。

gloss.en: A pale grass of the north-western steppe that turns white when it dries in autumn.
gloss.zh: 白草：西北边地的一种牧草，秋天干枯后变成白色。

gloss.en: A bow strengthened with horn; 控 is to draw. The cold has made it too stiff.
gloss.zh: 角弓：两端用兽角装饰的硬弓。控：拉开。

gloss.en: The protector-general, governor of a frontier protectorate.
gloss.zh: 都护：唐代镇守边疆的长官。

gloss.en: 瀚海: the great desert. 闌干: criss-crossing, spread everywhere.
gloss.zh: 瀚海：大沙漠。阑干：纵横交错的样子。

gloss.en: The gate of an army camp, once made of two carts with their shafts (轅) raised to face each other.
gloss.zh: 辕门：军营的门。古代扎营以车为屏障，出入处以两车车辕相向竖立为门。

gloss.en: Luntai, a Tang garrison town in present-day Xinjiang, where Cen Shen was serving.
gloss.zh: 轮台：唐代庭州属县，在今新疆境内，岑参当时在此任职。

note.en: A snowstorm becomes ten thousand pear trees in blossom, and the farewell ends on hoofprints in the snow; among the finest poems of the Tang frontier.
note.zh: 把一场暴雪写成千树万树梨花开，送别结束在雪上的马蹄印；唐代边塞诗中最出色的作品之一。
